title: Senior Manager IT
description:
We are seeking a **PLM****Solution****Architect** to lead the design and delivery of complex **PTC****Windchill** ecosystems. If you have experience with **PLM,****ERP,****CAD****integrations,****cloud****migration,****microservices,****Java,****and****enterprise****architecture**, this is your opportunity to work on cutting\-edge engineering and manufacturing transformation programs.  

Your role  

Key responsibilities in your new role

  

* Define and own the Windchill solution architecture, roadmap, standards, and implementation strategy aligned with business and enterprise goals.
* Gather and analyze business requirements, translating them into scalable and effective PLM solutions.
* Design and configure Windchill solutions covering product data, CAD management, workflows, lifecycles, roles, teams, and access controls.
* Provide technical leadership for Windchill customizations, code reviews, governance, and best practices.
* Architect integrations between Windchill and enterprise applications such as ERP, ALM, document management systems, and portals.
* Lead cloud migration, platform upgrades, data migration, and legacy system modernization initiatives.
* Drive digital engineering experiences through dashboards, portals, and connected solutions.
* Establish and support DevOps, CI/CD, automation, release management, and deployment practices.
* Mentor developers, architects, and project teams while ensuring delivery quality and technical excellence.
* Collaborate with stakeholders, business leaders, and IT teams to drive architecture decisions and solution adoption.
* Support pre\-sales activities, including solution design, effort estimation, RFP responses, and proof\-of\-concept demonstrations.
* Maintain architecture documentation, interface specifications, deployment guides, and knowledge\-sharing materials.
* Promote quality assurance, continuous improvement, training, and operational best practices.

  

Your profile  

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, Manufacturing, or a related field.
* Extensive experience in enterprise PLM architecture and large\-scale PTC Windchill implementations.
* Strong expertise in Windchill configuration, customization, workflows, lifecycles, object models, access control, teams, groups, and product/document management.
* Hands\-on experience with Java/J2EE, REST APIs, JavaScript/Node.js, Python, scripting, databases, and reporting technologies.
* Proven track record of designing and implementing integrations between PLM, ERP, ALM, CAD, IoT, document management systems, portals, and middleware platforms.
* Exposure to connected product and digital engineering solutions is preferred.
* Good understanding of cloud migration, microservices, platform upgrades, de\-customization, data migration, and legacy system modernization.
* Experience with Agile delivery, DevOps, CI/CD, source control, release management, automated testing, and environment governance.
* Ability to create and present solution architectures, interface designs, data flows, technical roadmaps, and proof of concepts (PoCs).
* Strong technical leadership with experience in team mentoring, solution reviews, issue resolution, and delivery ownership.
* Customer\-facing consulting experience, including stakeholder workshops, product demonstrations, pre\-sales support, RFP responses, and technical presentations.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, communication, stakeholder management, and interpersonal skills.
* Certifications such as PMP, TOGAF, PTC, Cloud, or Agile are an added advantage.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across global teams, locations, and time zones, including support during critical releases, migrations, and stabilization activities.

  

\#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
